The elements of group IA of modern periodic table is known as alkali metals. They are Li, Na, K, Rb, cs, Fr. The last electron is entered into the s-orbital of the electronic configuration. So, they are called s-block element.

Physical properties: i. They are very reactive and found in free states. ii. They have valency 1 i.e. monovalent. So, they have oxidation state +1. iii. They are highly electropositive metals. iv. They are soft metals. So, can be cut by knife easily. v. They are highly malleable and ductile. vi. They have very Iow specific gravity.
